findings.message: PROCESS: the rev-13 verify node found the SIXTH instance of the same failure mode (a fix on one surface, not its mirror: findContainerPath still built `/` + `/` so the HOST guard was inert for a root container path; displayProgram rendered a whole-command-line argv[0] and a URL's post-authority `@user:pass` tail; redactText consumed only up to the first `@`). All fixed in this revision by removing the class: one shared `isAtOrUnder`/`isSamePath` predicate, an enforced program rendering (first token, authority host only), and the deletion of the ledger's dead capture plumbing. Re-sealing.
